description: Open the Activity board, choose a real-data activity row with thread replies and reactions, open the in-place thread pane, scroll to the bottom, and verify reaction emoji glyphs render correctly.
preconditions: The real snapshot contains at least one group_message with reply_count > 0.
The selected event has at least one reaction so the probe can assert emoji glyph rendering.
The probe runs in the desktop viewport because compact shell navigation is a separate contract.
steps: Navigate to /web and wait for the app shell.
Find the activity row whose preview matches the selected real event body.
Click the row and wait for the thread pane to mount.
Scroll the thread body to the bottom.
Assert the composer remains available and at least one reaction button is visible.
Assert the expected emoji appears in both the reaction button text and accessible label without replacement characters.
assertions: .act-row matching real event text is visible.
.thread-pane and .thread-pane-body are visible after row click.
Reaction emoji text is present and not rendered as tofu or U+FFFD.
staleIf: Activity rows no longer open ThreadPane in place.
ThreadPane no longer renders MessageRow reaction buttons.
The real-data query cannot find a thread with reactions.
The referenced glossary components or active probe file disappear.
